title: Certified Robustness on Visual Graph Matching via Searching Optimal Smoothing Range

problem.claim: Deep visual graph matching is a combinatorial task that finds a permutation matrix representing keypoint correspondences between two images.

gap.claim: Certified robustness for deep visual graph matching remains an open challenge because paired inputs and a highly nonlinear permutation output space must be handled together, while balancing certified robustness against matching performance.

narrative_sequence.summary: Visual graph matching is framed as a challenging combinatorial correspondence problem between image keypoints.
Empirical studies are reported to show susceptibility to adversarial attacks and reliability issues in downstream applications.
Certified robustness remains open due to paired-input and nonlinear-output-space difficulties, together with a robustness-performance trade-off.
